findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "security" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_url_phishing, check_urls_phishing_batch, check_sanctions, check_sanctions_batch, detect_proxy, decode_calldata, get_allowance, check_security_headers, verify_email · Private data: scan_contract_source, check_contract_before_interaction, scan_agent_package, check_url_phishing, check_urls_phishing_batch, detect_proxy, decode_calldata, get_allowance, inspect_domain, check_security_headers, verify_email, rdap_lookup · Public sink: scan_contract_source, scan_contract_address, check_contract_before_interaction, scan_agent_package, check_url_phishing, check_sanctions, detect_proxy, decode_calldata, get_allowance, inspect_domain, verify_email, rdap_lookup · Destructive: scan_agent_package, check_security_headers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_url_phishing, check_urls_phishing_batch, check_sanctions, check_sanctions_batch, detect_proxy, decode_calldata, get_allowance, check_security_headers, verify_email · Private data: scan_contract_source, check_contract_before_interaction, scan_agent_package, check_url_phishing, check_urls_phishing_batch, detect_proxy, decode_calldata, get_allowance, inspect_domain, check_security_headers, verify_email, rdap_lookup · Public sink: scan_contract_source, scan_contract_address, check_contract_before_interaction, scan_agent_package, check_url_phishing, check_sanctions, detect_proxy, decode_calldata, get_allowance, inspect_domain, verify_email, rdap_lookup · Destructive: scan_agent_package, check_security_headers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
